# Foundations

Every scope answers the same five questions. This is the answer that sets each scope's values; open a scope for all five, its tokens and its specimen.

| Scope | Values | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Typography](./typography.md) | Regular | Regular body size suits all brands. |
| [Color](./color.md) | Balanced | Balanced, so any brand hue works. |
| [Spacing](./spacing.md) | Comfortable | Comfortable spacing in every brand. |
| [Shape](./shape.md) | Rounded | Rounded by default; each brand sets its own corner. |
| [Elevation](./elevation.md) | Soft | Soft shadows fit every brand. |
| [Motion](./motion.md) | Moderate | Moderate speed across brands. |
| [Iconography](./iconography.md) | Match the text | Icons match the text. |
| [Theming](./theming.md) | Light and dark | Light and dark ship for every brand. |
| [Accessibility](./accessibility.md) | Touch size | Customers sign up on phones. |
| [Naming](./naming.md) | Lowercase words in paths | Lowercase paths read the same everywhere. |
| [Voice and tone](./voice.md) | Plain and direct | The shared core is plain and direct. |
| [Components](./components.md) | Also for emphasis and size | Variants for emphasis and size let each brand feel present without new components. |
